rows.grounds: numeral component qualifying the following thousands
locative plural indicating the quantity within which torment occurs
compound of yoni (womb/source) and yantra (mechanism/diagram) in locative plural
past passive participle describing those subjected to suffering

items.question: What is the extent of torment experienced within the womb-mechanisms?
premises: This torment occurs within those womb-mechanisms.
items.inference: Beings suffer torment throughout the vast array of eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
uncertainties: The subject of pīḍitāḥ is implied from context rather than explicitly stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
